title: Repository Exclusion Register — the declared classification of every excluded path
authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH, HELD SUBORDINATE UNDER UCKP-LAW-0001. This register legislates the classification of excluded filesystem state; it is not generated and must never be regenerated.

constitutional_superior.effect: UCKP-ART-09 makes the repository one persistence mechanism among several, so exclusion from it is a statement about STORAGE and never about whether a thing exists. This register owns which bytes the version-control binding carries; it may never own existence.

why_this_exists: UCOS-RIB-001 measured repository cleanliness as a count over `git status --porcelain`.
That command applies the ignore authority, so the exclusion rules were an INPUT to the
gate that polices excluded state. At be46a300 two lines added to .gitignore removed 41
physically-present contaminating files from the gate's observation surface, flipping
GATE-12 and GATE-04, opening rib.json:gate, satisfying AEE OBS-BLUEPRINT-GATE and
clearing CONV-02 — on a repository that still held every one of those files.
The correction is not a better pattern. It is that EXCLUSION MUST COST A DECLARATION.
Repository cleanliness is now measured over the ignored-inclusive filesystem, and every
ignored path must resolve to a class declared HERE. An ignored path with no declared
class is `ignored_unclassified` and FAILS CLOSED. Adding an ignore rule therefore no
longer removes an observation; it adds a classification obligation. The metric cannot
be shrunk by editing .gitignore, which is the property that was missing.

classes.GENERATED_DETERMINISTIC: Deterministically re-derivable output of a declared producer. Regenerated each run, never hand-registered (GOV-005 §5.3). Byte-identical from the same tracked inputs.
classes.GENERATED_ENVIRONMENTAL: Output of a declared producer whose bytes depend on the execution environment. Never an input to canonical identity.
classes.TEST_EXECUTION_ARTIFACT: Produced by the test runner. Absent from every pristine clone because the bootstrap does not run the suite. Never an input to canonical identity (UCOS-CL-005).
classes.CACHE: Interpreter or tool cache. Reconstructible from source at any time; carries no information.
classes.TOOL_OPERATIONAL: Per-clone operational state of a development tool or environment. Not repository truth, not shared, not reproducible across machines.
classes.TEMPORARY: Transient lock or editor scratch file with a bounded lifetime, owned by the process that creates it.
classes.EXPLICITLY_AUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL: Present by explicit authorization and outside the governed corpus by declaration, not by accident.

invariants: Every ignored path resolves to exactly one entry here (`ignored_unclassified` = 0).
No tracked path is matched by any ignore rule (`git check-ignore --no-index` over `git ls-files` is empty).
No entry may be added for a path whose correct disposition is deletion — exclusion is not a disposal mechanism.
Adding a rule here does not reduce the contamination count unless the class is one this register declares.

imports.py was identified as an unverified orphan: no __init__.py, no importers, no tests, not packaged or covered. Excluded from the RC-1 baseline until it is wired and tested, so it is not sealed as verified implementation. This exclusion carries a disposition obligation, not a permanent licence.
Operator archive held outside the governed corpus by declaration.

Version-control transport container — a serialization of the object database for backup or offline transfer, classified CLS-TRANSIENT by UCOS-RFP-001. Bundles belong in durable storage outside the repository; the rule exists so one written into the tree by accident is bounded rather than counted.

The Verification Evidence Registry: a content-addressed cache of stage results, keyed by digests over content hashes UCOS-UGA-001 already publishes. Deleting the whole store changes no verdict, only the cost of reaching one, so it holds no information the tracked corpus does not. Its ignore rule predates this entry; the entry is what makes the rule resolve.

The execution-environment fingerprint cache and the per-run execution evidence. Both describe THIS MACHINE: an interpreter path, a venv prefix, an installed toolchain — none of which reproduces elsewhere, so committing either would publish a claim true only where it was written. The cache may skip exactly one measurement and never a verdict, and the evidence is emitted fresh by every certified run and bound into certification from there, not from git. It also holds verify.lease, the working-tree lease AEOS G-04 names (scripts/ucos-env.sh, acquired by verify.sh before any stage runs). The class is unchanged and correct: a lease records THIS MACHINE's pid, the HEAD it measured and the porcelain digest it measured, none of which reproduces elsewhere, and it is owned by the process that writes it for exactly the duration of one run. Committing it would publish a claim about a process that no longer exists.

Generated context projection — the canonical context root — index, sixteen domain pages and the projection manifest. Deterministically re-derived from the authored declaration at 00-BOOK/DATA/context-authority.json; byte-identical from the same tracked inputs (UCKP-ART-13). Under GOV-005 §5.3 a generated artifact is regenerated, never hand-registered, so it is not an eligible repository artifact and consumes no permanent identity. Regenerate: `python3 00-BOOK/tools/ukctx.py build`. Bootstrap: emitted by scripts/generate-prerequisites.sh at verify.sh stage 1b, so a pristine clone obtains it before any gate reads it. Fixed point proved by INV-CTX-11 and by the CI job 'Fixed point — a build over the committed tree writes no byte'; absence or drift is refused by INV-CTX-06 and INV-CTX-07. This entry is what makes the ignore rule lawful: exclusion here is a statement about STORAGE, never about whether the context exists.

Per-developer operational state of the local agent runtime — the scheduled-task lock file. Never shared, never repository truth, and never an input to canonical identity. Declared here because it was previously excluded ONLY by .git/info/exclude, which no clone carries: the path was ignored on one machine and untracked-and-unignored on every other. UCOS-UCTX-001 INV-CTX-12 walks agent directories ignored-inclusive and refuses an unclassified file, so the missing declaration made the context gate fail for a reason that had nothing to do with governance. Same class the register already assigns to settings.local.json; distinct from GENERATED_DETERMINISTIC because nothing produces these from a declared input and no command reproduces them.

Phase 10 context closure certification. Carries no clock, so it is byte-identical from identical tracked inputs and reaches a fixed point its own --check proves. It is a measurement ABOUT the context authority, never an input to one, so it is product rather than truth and is excluded under the same Model B decision that excludes the projections themselves.
